turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: Slack export · #deal-sunpeak-renewal Exported 10/20/2026 12:06 PM · 20 messages [10/20/2026 11:20 AM] [PERSON_1].alvarez: kicking off the renewal debrief here. call ran long, amanda, marisol & [PERSON_2] from sunpeak. quick heads up: this is the renewal call from yesterday, not the qbr. qbr is still on the calendar for nov 5. [10/20/2026 11:22 AM] [PERSON_1].alvarez: amanda wants the voice agent pricing restructured or she's capping the whole deal at 200k ↳ [10/20/2026 11:24 AM] [PERSON_3].donovan: so that's a 68k gap. what's driving it, seat count or the usage line? ↳ [10/20/2026 11:26 AM] [PERSON_1].alvarez: usage. they're at 70 seats & not moving off that. the agent minutes are what she keeps pointing at. said the math doesn't work for 3 markets when they're only staffing the voice agent in TX rn. [10/20/2026 11:29 AM] [PERSON_4].morrison: what term are they asking for? one year or are they open to 24? ↳ [10/20/2026 11:31 AM] [PERSON_1].alvarez: they'll do 24 if the number works. amanda said she'd sign a two-year today at 200. i don't think she moves off that without something on the agent side. [10/20/2026 11:33 AM] [PERSON_3].donovan: ok. i'll pull the deal desk sheet together. [PERSON_4], can we mdel a usage tier reset instead of a flat discount? feels cleaner than cutting list. ↳ [10/20/2026 11:35 AM] [PERSON_4].morrison: can do. send me the current agent minute run rate & their commit from last year & i'll have two options by thursday. [10/20/2026 11:38 AM] [PERSON_1].alvarez: sending now. also fyi [PERSON_2] forwarded callrail's same-day sync one-pager to marisol & their CEO ↳ [10/20/2026 11:40 AM] [PERSON_5].reyes: :eyes: when did that land? ↳ [10/20/2026 11:42 AM] [PERSON_1].alvarez: [PERSON_2] mentioned it on the call, said marisol got it last week. he didn't say who sent it originally. i've got the one-pager [PERSON_5], want me to forward it? ↳ [10/20/2026 11:44 AM] [PERSON_5].reyes: yes pls. send it to me & i'll get the counter sheet updated. same-day sync is their whole pitch rn so i want to see how they're framing it. [10/20/2026 11:47 AM] [PERSON_1].alvarez: on it. also pasting the three lines from the recording where [PERSON_2] gets into the google ads stuff, since that's the part that matters for the counter:

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: "the conversions are still a day or two late in google ads and that's honestly what's killing us"

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: "we're bidding blind for 24 hours, so by the time the conversion shows up the auction's already moved"

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: "marisol keeps asking me why our cost per lead on meta looks fine & google looks terrible, and it's the same lag" [10/20/2026 11:50 AM] [PERSON_3].donovan: that's the real thing then. pricing is the ask, the lag is the why. did you commit to anything on the call? ↳ [10/20/2026 11:52 AM] [PERSON_1].alvarez: no. i said i'd take it back & come with a proposal. didn't promise a date. ↳ [10/20/2026 11:54 AM] [PERSON_3].donovan: good. don't put a number in writing until [PERSON_4]'s options are back. i'll loop in the pricing call for thursday. [10/20/2026 11:56 AM] [PERSON_4].morrison: :+1: & if they push on the 200 number on the call, stall. tell them we're working the agent side. [10/20/2026 11:59 AM] [PERSON_1].alvarez: will do. one more thing, amanda asked if we can get the proposal before their board meeting on the 29th. i told her i'd try but no promises. ↳ [10/20/2026 12:01 PM] [PERSON_3].donovan: 29th is tight but doable. thursday options, friday internal, monday to them. put it on my calendar. [10/20/2026 12:03 PM] [PERSON_1].alvarez: done. thx all.
